fieldDescriptions.componentCount: Number of Components in Multiple System

metadata.title: Bright Star Catalog, 5th Revised Edition (Preliminary Version)
metadata.authors: D. Hoffleit and W. H. Warren Jr. (1991)
metadata.provenance: Yale Bright Star Catalog hosted and maintained by NASA HEASARC; not a NASA observing mission.
metadata.query: SELECT hr, hd, sao, alt_name, ra, dec, vmag, spect_type, bv_color, parallax, par_code, pmra, pmdec, var_id, multiple, m_cnt, radvel, radvel_comm, vmag_code, vmag_uncert, bv_uncert FROM bsc5p ORDER BY hr
metadata.scope: Complete stellar subset of BSC5P, predominantly stars brighter than apparent magnitude 6.5; not a catalogue of every known star.
metadata.distancePolicy: Raw parallax is preserved. BSC5P provides no parallax uncertainty here; no distance is inferred in this snapshot. D denotes a dynamical parallax; blank denotes trigonometric when a parallax is present.
metadata.photometryPolicy: vmag preserves the catalogue value and its code. R denotes reduced HR photometry; H denotes original HR photometry. Uncertainty flags are retained.
metadata.missingValue: null; zero and negative parallax measurements are retained as recorded, not treated as valid distances
